tasks.prompt: Creating the iterator returned by Parser::values() and dropping it without reading any values unexpectedly changes later parsing. After reading the option in ['-a', 'b'], checking values().is_ok() should leave 'b' available to value(). Attached values and grouped short options should also remain available when that iterator is unused. Fix this behavior, preserve actual iteration and option-boundary behavior, and add regression coverage.
tasks.regression_provenance: Upstream commit adds four unused-iterator regression cases and documents the changed behavior in its changelog.

tasks.prompt: On Unix, malformed non-UTF-8 bytes in grouped short options produce too many replacement-character options. For the raw argument bytes [45, 240, 157, 97], parsing should yield Short('�') followed by Short('a'); the incomplete argument [45, 240, 157] should yield just Short('�'). Keep valid Unicode, separate invalid sequences, subsequent options, and raw option values intact. Fix the inconsistency and add regression coverage.

tasks.prompt: parse_duration panics for the input '18446744073709551615s1000ms', although oversized durations should return DurationError::NumberOverflow. Splitting the extra second into '999999999ns 1ns' has the same problem. Fix this behavior while preserving representable durations near the limit and ordinary duration parsing. Add regression coverage and keep the existing suite passing.

tasks.prompt: A recursive glob behaves differently when enclosed in parentheses. For example, picomatch.isMatch('test/utils', 'test(/utils/**)') returns false, while the recursive suffix should allow the directory itself as well as descendants. The optional form 'test?(/utils/**)' should also accept that directory. Fix this inconsistency while preserving strictSlashes, nonterminal patterns, and negated extglob behavior. Add regression coverage and keep the existing suite passing.
tasks.title: Parenthesized recursive patterns omit their parent directory

tasks.prompt: The scan API does not consistently return all pattern parts. For example, scan('foo', {parts: true}).parts is [] rather than ['foo'], and scan('/a/b/', {parts: true}).parts loses the empty leading/trailing segments. Make parts consistently describe the full pattern after its recognized prefix, including when tokens are requested. Path separators within escaped sequences, bracket expressions, and nested parentheses must not split a part. Preserve the other scan metadata and existing matching behavior. Add regression coverage.
tasks.title: scan returns incomplete path parts

tasks.prompt: With Windows mode enabled, basename matching fails for backslash-separated paths. For example, picomatch.isMatch('foo\\bar.js', 'bar.js', {basename: true, windows: true}) returns false; it should return true. The same applies to the matchBase option and direct matchBase API calls. Correct this behavior without changing ordinary POSIX matching or treating backslashes as path separators when Windows mode is disabled. Add regression tests and keep the existing suite passing.
tasks.title: Windows basename matching ignores backslash separators
